# doc: expect 42
record Point:
    x: int
    y: int


enum Shape:
    empty
    radius(value: int)
    point(value: Point)


record Node:
    value: int


func main() -> int:
    if Point(x=1, y=2) != Point(x=1, y=2):
        return 1
    if Shape.radius(value=4) == Shape.point(value=Point(x=4, y=0)):
        return 2
    if Node(value=1) != Node(value=1):
        return 3
    mut first = Node(value=1)
    if first != first:
        return 4
    return 42

# doc: expect 20
func main() -> int:
    mut squares = [for i in range(5) yield i * i]
    mut total = 0
    for s in squares:
        total = total + s
    return total - 10

# doc: expect hello7
# doc: expect hello7!
func main(out: Stream) -> int:
    mut text = "hello" + str(7)
    const saved = text.copy()
    text += "!"
    out.print(saved)
    out.print(text)
    return 0
